text: {"lessons":["Selling some Stock D after large gains reduced my exposure, but I should not assume I can time the market; use a planned target allocation instead.","My account still fluctuated after I made no trades, so I will review risk and diversification regularly rather than equating inaction with safety.","Because I depend on these savings for retirement, I will keep enough cash for near-term expenses and avoid letting any one stock dominate my account."]}
